summary: Tested TrapClub backend (4 endpoints incl. SSE chat) and frontend (server status, announcements, AI chat streaming). All 6 pytest cases pass; all 3 UI checks pass. Backend correctly answers from knowledge base (VIP prices 75/149/299, server IP play.trapclub.net) instead of falling back to Discord. SSE stream is well-formed (`data: {token}` + `data: [DONE]`) and consumed correctly by the React frontend. Server status endpoint returns the exact required shape and completes within ~1s; `online:false` is expected in this sandbox as noted.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py loads knowledge_base.md on every request via build_system_prompt(); consider caching at module load to reduce IO per chat request.
MC status endpoint uses a 4s asyncio.wait_for around a 3s mcstatus timeout — fine, but consider caching the last successful status for a few seconds to avoid hammering the MC server on burst traffic.
CORS is wildcard from env default — acceptable for a public read-only site but worth pinning to trapclub.net in production.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py covers /api/health, /api/announcements, /api/server/status shape+latency, and 3 SSE chat scenarios (server IP, VIP prices, ban-> discord). It parses SSE via requests stream and asserts on concatenated token content. Frontend testids used: server-status-card, server-status-indicator, announcements-panel, ai-chat-panel, chat-input, chat-send-button, chat-messages, quick-question-<label prefix>. Note server 'online:false' in sandbox is expected and NOT a bug.
